<h1 class="brief-title">About Emily Stern</h1>

<p class="deck">Data analyst with three years of combined analytics, applied research, and direct service experience supporting low-income families and economically vulnerable households — two promotions in two years at the Child Poverty Action Lab.</p>

<p class="byline"><strong>Plano, TX</strong></p>

::: {.brief-section}

[01 — Experience]{.section-num}

## Roles

### Data Analyst — Child Poverty Action Lab
*Dallas, TX · May 2024 – Present*

- Redesigned a financial analytics system modeling revenue variation across service type, delivery channel, and payer mix, improving visibility across approximately $1.08M annually in managed cash flows and supporting operational and strategic decision-making for finance teams.
- Built and maintained stakeholder-facing dashboards and analytical applications across six program areas, integrating multi-source datasets into real-time decision tools that reduced manual reporting overhead by 8–10 hours per week.
- Designed a probabilistic record-linkage and evaluation pipeline analyzing how housing instability relates to long-term student outcomes, applying matched-sampling methods and ordinal logistic regression.
- Developed scalable Databricks data pipelines with API integrations, schema design, and historical change tracking, creating clean and reliable datasets for downstream analytics and operational use cases.
- Designed KPI-driven dashboards and analytical frameworks to monitor program performance, surface emerging trends, and support data-informed prioritization for public-sector partners.
- Developed predictive spatial risk models identifying environmental patterns associated with violent crime risk, partnering with operational stakeholders to translate findings into targeted intervention strategies.

### Impact Data Assistant — Girls Inc. of Metropolitan Dallas
*Part-time · Dallas, TX · Jan 2024 – Aug 2024*

- Analyzed program performance against logic-model outcomes for youth development programs serving underserved communities; established Compass 365 data collection protocols that improved reporting consistency across multiple program sites.

### Culturally Responsive Research in Developmental Science Fellow — National Science Foundation
*Richardson, TX · Aug 2023 – Aug 2024*

- Selected for a competitive national fellowship in developmental science; applied research design and systematic literature review to community-based research with a focus on culturally responsive methods.

### "Juega Conmigo" Program Facilitator — UT Dallas Center for Children and Families
*Aug 2023 – May 2024*

- Co-facilitated a bilingual playful-learning program for children 0–3 and their families, coaching parents on research-based strategies to support optimal child development.

### Crisis Advocate — Hope's Door New Beginning Center
*Full-time · Plano, TX · Jan 2023 – Dec 2023*

- Served survivors of domestic violence and their families in emergency shelters; operated a 24-hour crisis hotline, conducted case management, and connected survivors to local resources as they navigated rebuilding financial and household stability.

:::
